title: Smoked Salmon and Lentil Salad
description: Lentils join smoked salmon, red onion, and chives in this tasty lentil salad that can be served for dinner or lunch.
ingredients: 10 ounces smoked salmon, or more to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Combine water, lentils, and bouquet garni in a large saucepan; bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer until lentils are tender but still firm and there is only a little excess cooking liquid in the pan, about 20 minutes. Remove from the heat and let lentils cool in the pan. Discard bouquet garni.
Cut salmon into small strips, no longer than 1/2 inch long. Place in a large bowl with onion and chives. Add cooled lentils.

Whisk olive oil, vinegar, mustard, salt, and pepper together in a small bowl. Add to the lentil mixture and stir until well combined. Serve immediately or refrigerate until flavors have blended, 2 to 3 hours.
